skills.name: May my agent fetch this?
skills.description: Use this before your agent fetches a page ("may my agent fetch this?"). Pass the `url` and your `agent` token. A2A: metadata.gaip_tool "gaip_check_permission".

skills.name: Has anyone withdrawn or warned about this server?

skills.name: Did a server I depend on change?

skills.name: May my agent approach this person or agent?

skills.name: Accept registered terms (the other party)

skills.name: Was the agreed rule met? (signed finding)

skills.name: Who is this agent approaching mine?

skills.name: Was this agent mandated to act for them, as indexed?

skills.name: Record a role's decision on a proposal (sign-off)

skills.name: What did this agent say it runs on, on a date?

skills.name: Where did this agent's endpoint answer from, on a date?

skills.name: What did my agents do this month?

listings.description: Zambo is the verifiable work layer for AI. Give your AI hands, memory, and proof: one URL, no key for the free tier (Every tool is free once a day, plus 3 continue calls. One free wrap-up handover per day, and pickup is always free. The Day Pass makes every tool unlimited for 24 hours for $0.99.). The flagship product is HANDOVER, which hands work from one AI to another with a receipt trail. Every job returns a verifiable AER-1 receipt (IETF Internet-Draft draft-zambo-aer1-26): a receipt proves the saved result was not changed since it was saved, not that the answer was right. The skills below are MCP-backed capabilities, served over MCP at https://zambo.dev/mcp today.

skills.name: Verify a receipt
skills.description: Check a Zambo receipt: recompute the sha-256 digest of the exact saved bytes and confirm the saved result was not changed since it was saved. A verified receipt does not prove the answer was right. Served over MCP at https://zambo.dev/mcp and on the web at https://zambo.dev/verify/.

skills.name: Hand over work between AIs
